Buy brass-thread spools (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)

events.description: A candlelit ferry of round stitched moth dolls follows the Lantern Monk's glowing pole across dark teal water.

Trade two bundles of pitchfork twine (spend 2 scraps; gain 29 gold)
Leave the orchard to its crows
